question:
$ABCD$ is a trapezium such that $AB$ is parallel to $DC$ and $\dfrac{AB}{DC}=\alpha>1$. Suppose $P$ and $Q$ are points on $AC$ and $BD$ respectively, such that
\[
\frac{AP}{AC}=\frac{BQ}{BD}=\frac{\alpha-1}{\alpha+1}.
\]
Show that $PQCD$ is a parallelogram.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
